stock.description: Established in 1991 and headquartered in Wan Chai, Hong Kong, Great World Company Holdings Ltd operates as an investment firm with a diverse portfolio of businesses. Formerly known as T S Telecom Technologies Limited until its rebranding in November 2008, the company specializes in offering intelligent advertising and bespoke marketing solutions, primarily within the People's Republic of China. Its operations are structured into four key divisions: Intelligent Advertising and Railroad Media; Agricultural, Forestry and Consumer Products; Supply-Chain; and Property. The property segment is dedicated to real estate investment, development, and the management of both residential and commercial properties. Its agricultural and consumer goods arm focuses on cultivating forestry and timber products, Chinese herbal medicines, and specialized agricultural commodities, alongside selling packaged and pre-prepared food items, promoting agricultural technologies, and providing related information consulting. The advertising and media division encompasses magazine publishing, mobile advertising platforms catering to various clients including the property sector, railway magazine distribution, and e-commerce platform management. Furthermore, Great World Company is involved in the distribution of industrial and information technology products, conducts associated research and development, and engages in general trading and product manufacturing activities.
